criteria.defer_to_prepare: Requiredness stays undecided at read time, so unproduced types display as unresolved; the subsequent Standard drafting pass determines which types the route warrants, creates them, and records the rest as not required with reasons.
criteria.evidence_keyword: A deterministic evidence test sets requiredness and cites its basis: employer questions on file trigger form values; an email address inside the destination triggers the email subject and body; sourced requirements or attachment prompts naming a CV or letter trigger those; every other type is declared not required with its reason; without a verified route all types stay unresolved.
criteria.fixed_kind_map: A hard-coded table keys requiredness off route kind only: direct means CV plus letter plus form values, referral or recruiter means email subject plus email body plus CV, and other judgments yield unresolved or not required regardless of what the questions and requirements say.

instructions: Act as a design adviser for a job-hunt helper that never contacts employers. Review the scenario and the invariant facts, then choose the readiness approach that best honors the acceptance gates. Rank highest the approach that grounds each required or not-required verdict in verified evidence, never imposes a one-size-fits-all document list, never fabricates employer demands, and computes requiredness with plain deterministic logic on the read path.

state.context: When the owner reaches material preparation, the app has to show exactly which artifacts the vacancy warrants: a CV, a motivation letter, email components, or field values for the employer's form. Verified inputs available are the application-route record, the employer's real questions, and quoted requirement statements. Each artifact type carries a readiness verdict: ready if a current version is saved, held if required but missing answers, not required if affirmatively excluded, unresolved if the evidence is silent. The decision at hand is the requiredness rule for routes verified as real application channels.

facts.formValuesRule: derived at read time from saved answers; never stored
gates: A4: unused type marked not required, not fabricated
P02: materials the vacancy actually calls for; no universal checklist
routeValidation: application_route judgment requires direct|referral|recruiter kind plus non-empty destinationText

state.question: Which requiredness rule best fits the deterministic per-type readiness verdicts for verified application channels?
